heading: Your humble guide
bio: B has a deep respect for what the mind can do when it is given the space. She supports people with many different experiences, ranging from deep despair to sweet curiosity. She helps them find their way back to themselves and those they love.

At the heart of her work is a simple truth: The way in is the way out. Our journeys call for safety, curiosity, and courage. These journeys are one way of reaching the quieter, more resilient part of yourself - the one that has been there all along - a world within.

She'll prepare you properly, stay with you through the whole of it, and sit with you afterward while you make sense of what you found. People describe her space as warm, grounded, and accepting. She meets you exactly where you are — not where you think you ought to be.
Whether you are worn down by the weight of the world, or simply sense there is more waiting for you, Becky's curiosity can lead you to yours.
intro: Becky is well-trained and well-resourced to keep you safe, but what's more important is her belief that you already have everything you need within you. Ready when you are.
credentialsEmpty: A World Within LLC provides holistic integration coaching, spiritual support, and educational resources. We do not provide medical, clinical, or psychological therapy, nor do we diagnose or treat any medical or mental health condition. Our services do not involve the provision, manufacture, or administration of any illegal or controlled substances. Seeking guidance through non-ordinary states of consciousness involves personal choice and risk; our role is strictly limited to non-clinical preparation, harm reduction education, and integration support.
ctaHeading: Would you like to know more
approachesIntro: A few threads run through everything Becky does, woven differently for each person who sits down with her.

approaches.title: Tuning into your parts
approaches.body: Yourself will tell you just about everything you need to know. You just need a treasure map. Turns out, Becky has one. It's meditative, it's reflective, it's exploratory, and it's very real opportunity to get to know yourself.

approaches.title: Slow is smooth
approaches.body:
Your system sets the pace and Becky helps you find your rhythm, but... we go low and slow.
Coming to each trailhead with curiosity.

approaches.title: Extra-Ordinary
approaches.body: Meditation; non-ordinary states of consciousness; spirituality; deep-inner exploration; curiosity; neuroplasticity.

metaDescription: Explore non-ordinary states of consciousness safely. Receive non-clinical, unlicensed holistic guidance and integration support for deep inner healing and personal growth
